newsitem.title: FRANCE: French ex-communist Chief Marchais leaves hospital. [CORRECTED 01:34 GMT 31/12]
newsitem.headline: French ex-communist Chief Marchais leaves hospital. [CORRECTED 01:34 GMT 31/12]

text.p: Veteran former French Communist party (PCF) leader Georges Marchais on Monday left the Paris hospital where he was being treated for a recurring heart ailment, his party said.
The 76-year-old Marchais, who was taken to the Lariboisiere hospital on December 11, was fitted with a pacemaker, the PCF said in a statement.

A hardliner who approved of Soviet intervention in Afghanistan in 1979, Marchais led France's once-powerful Communist party, long one of Moscow's staunchest allies in Western Europe, from 1972 until he handed over to Robert Hue three years ago.
